abstract: OBJECTIVE: To investigate the profile of children with benign testicular tumors and compare the prevalence of testis-sparing surgery (TSS) in two periods. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Data from children with testicular benign tumors who were admitted to our hospital from January 2004 to March 2024 were retrospectively retrieved and multidisciplinary evaluation was administered beginning in 2018. Statistical analysis was performed to analyze the factors associated with TSS. RESULTS: There were 51 children with benign tumors, including 24 with teratomas, 21 with epidermoid cysts, 3 with adenomas, 2 with mesothelial cysts and 1 with sex cord–stromal tumor. Four patients had elevated serum AFP levels, and preoperative ultrasound examination of 5 patients revealed malignant tumors with normal tumor markers. Twenty-six patients underwent TSS, and frozen-section examination was performed in 18 patients, which was consistent with the final pathological results. Since 2018, the proportion of TSS increased significantly compared with that in the previous period(19/25 vs. 7/26, p < 0.001). Multiparameter analysis revealed that tumor size and period were significantly associated with TSS (p = 0.002 and 0.002, respectively). The median follow-up time was 44 months, and none of the interviewed patients experienced any complications. The median sizes of the healthy testis and the involved testis were 26 mm and 23 mm, respectively. A > 10 mm difference in testis size was detected in 2 patients. CONCLUSIONS: The overtreatment of pediatric testicular benign tumors is not uncommon. A comprehensive evaluation should be conducted, and testis-sparing surgery should be considered if feasible. Children seem to have similar sized testes after testis-sparing surgery.
abstract_ja: 目的: 小児の精巣良性腫瘍の特徴を調べ、2つの期間における精巣温存手術(TSS)の施行率を比較する。方法: 2004年1月から2024年3月に当院に入院した、精巣良性腫瘍の小児の患者データを後方視的に抽出した。2018年から多職種評価を導入した。TSSに関連する因子を統計解析により検討した。結果: 良性腫瘍の小児51例で、内訳は奇形腫24例、類表皮嚢胞21例、腺腫3例、中皮嚢胞2例、性索間質性腫瘍1例であった。血清AFP高値が4例にみられ、術前超音波で腫瘍マーカーが正常にもかかわらず悪性腫瘍が疑われた症例が5例あった。26例にTSSを施行し、18例で術中迅速病理診断を施行し、最終病理結果と一致した。2018年以降、TSSの割合は有意に増加した(19/25 対 7/26、p < 0.001)。多変量解析では、腫瘍径と時期がTSSと有意に関連していた(それぞれp = 0.002および0.002)。中央値44か月の経過観察で、面談できた患者に合併症はなかった。健側精巣と患側精巣の中央値は、それぞれ26 mmおよび23 mmであった。精巣サイズの差が10 mmを超えたのは2例であった。結論: 小児の精巣良性腫瘍の過剰治療は少なくない。包括的な評価を行い、可能な場合は精巣温存手術を考慮すべきである。精巣温存手術後の小児では、精巣の大きさは同程度になるようである。
